title: Say Echo ed Saray Pukdol
intro: Isipen pa so sakey a lawak ya saray ayaman et ginawa ed saray pukdol, tan say dagem et walaan na pakanodnonotan na sakey a pasakbay ya ag-inimano. Sakey a totoo so datin binmulaslas dia, abendisyonan balet ta masungdo, anggad walay pinmaway a tanda manlapud mismon bato ya panmamatalkan da.
clues: Sikami so totoon nanggawa na maligen iran ayaman manlapud kapalandeyan, a nalilikna min maligen ira ed saray mabaton ayaman mi.
Nanayam kami ed dalin ya napno na saray patar tan bato, ya abendisyonan na saray hardin tan subol.
Sinmabi so sakey a mensahero a nanlapud limog tayo, ya anawag ed sikatayo ya taynanan iray palson dirios tayo tan dayewen so Sakey a tuan Manamalsa.
Mapaatagey kamin angiter na kondisyon parad sisiaen: sakey a nikadkaduman tanda ya ompaway ed saray mismon bato ya inukit mi.
Nen pinmatnag so insipan a kabatyan a kamelyo manlapud bato, sakey a malinew a tanda, ag nin siansia inmabuloy iray elite mi tan sikatoy pinaltog da anggaman ed pasakbay na onsasabin kadederal.
Taloy agew kayari na ginawa mi, walay maksil ya karol ya inmawet ed lawak, tan nagmaliw kamin naplag a geray, saray kaabungan mi et saray ponponan mi.

trial.label: Say Trial/Main Event Mi
options: Say panag-ipit na ulpo na kabatyan a kamelyo nen Allah
Say panagdayew ed balitok a kilaw a baka
Say pangipaalagey na tori ya anggad tawen
trial.answer: Say panag-ipit na ulpo na kabatyan a kamelyo nen Allah

location.label: Manunan Elemento ed Istorya Mi
options: Say kabatyan a kamelyo nen Allah
location.answer: Say kabatyan a kamelyo nen Allah

outcome.label: Say Pansumpalan Mi
options: Say inkaderal na makapaemel ya insabog
Sakey ya uran na bato manlapud tawen
Sakey a delap ya amaknol ed dalin
Sakey a maksil a dagem ya amawala ed sikami
Say dalin ya mangakmon ed sikatayo
outcome.answer: Say inkaderal na makapaemel ya insabog

arabic: وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَآ إِلَىٰ ثَمُودَ أَخَاهُمْ صَـٰلِحًا أَنِ ٱعْبُدُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ فَإِذَا هُمْ فَرِيقَانِ يَخْتَصِمُونَ
verse: And We had certainly sent to Thamūd their brother Ṣāliḥ, [saying], "Worship Allāh," and at once they were two parties conflicting. (27:45)
